visual.name: bfusionKpiGrid
visual.description: Flexible KPI grid: bind any row identity + any number of measure columns. Auto-detected renderers (number, progress, variance, status pill, sparkline, date), KPI strip, smart-insight rail. Designed for PPM portfolio/program/project rollups.

dataRoles.name: row
dataRoles.description: Row identity — primary name shown in the first column (e.g. Project, Program, Resource). Up to 3 fields allowed; additional fields become drill-down levels.

dataRoles.name: rowMeta
dataRoles.description: Optional second line shown under the row identity (e.g. project code, owner). Multiple fields concatenated with ' | '.

dataRoles.name: status
dataRoles.description: Optional. Drives the colored status dot on the left of each row. Values matching On Track / Healthy → green; At Risk / Watch / Amber → amber; Off Track / Critical / Overdue → red.

dataRoles.name: period
dataRoles.description: Optional. Time-period field (e.g. Month, Quarter, FY). When bound, the dataView is pulled at (Row × Period) granularity. The grid still shows one row per Row identity (aggregated) and each KPI tile auto-draws a trend sparkline grouped by Period — no per-period measures needed.

dataRoles.name: columns
dataRoles.description: Any measure or text/date column. Click the gear icon (⚙) on a column header to configure how it is visualized — number, money, percent, progress bar, bullet chart, variance, status pill, date, bar/line sparkline, or box plot.

dataRoles.name: kpis
dataRoles.description: Optional. Measures shown in the KPI strip across the top of the visual, independent of the grid columns. Hidden when none are bound.

dataRoles.name: tooltips
dataRoles.description: Optional. Additional fields surfaced in the Power BI tooltip on row hover; not rendered as grid columns.

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model

mode.description: Surface theme for the visual chrome. Auto follows the report theme's background.

background.description: Custom mode only. Plot and root background.

surface.description: Custom mode only. Header, toolbar, panels, tiles and tooltips.

textColor.description: Custom mode only. Primary text colour.

mutedColor.description: Custom mode only. Labels, captions and axis text.

ruleColor.description: Custom mode only. Separators, tile borders and axis lines.

freezeFirstColumn.description: Pin the row-identity column when scrolling horizontally.

compactRows.description: Tighter row height for denser grids.

showColumnTotals.description: Render a Portfolio Totals row with sum / avg per numeric column.

showPillRollup.description: Show stacked status counts (✓ ⚠ ✗) on group subtotal rows for columns rendered as status pills.

pinTotalsTop.description: Show the totals row above the data rows (sticky). When off, totals appear at the bottom.

showStatusDot.description: Render the colored dot at the left of each row when a Status field is bound.

showSearchBox.description: Render the search input in the header. Filters visible rows locally (does not cross-filter).

showFooterLegend.description: Render the status + series legend bar at the bottom.

showKpiStrip.description: Show the KPI tiles strip at the top of the visual. Quick toggle is also available in the header.

showConfigGear.description: Show the gear (⚙) icon on each column header to open the visualization configuration dialog.

columnConfigs.description: Auto-managed by the visual — stores per-column visualization settings. Edit via the gear (⚙) icon on each column header inside the visual; this field is here for portability.

columnOrder.description: Auto-managed by the visual — JSON array of column names in display order. Adjust via the Move ← / → buttons in the configure dialog.

rowHeaderLabel.description: Header text for the row-identity column. Default: "Name".

groupByColumn.description: Backward-compat for single-level grouping. Read only when groupByColumns is empty. Edit grouping via the ⚙ on each column.

groupByColumns.description: Auto-managed by the visual — JSON array of column names defining the grouping hierarchy (level 0 outermost). Up to 3 levels. Toggle each column via the ⚙ on its header.

collapsedGroups.description: Auto-managed by the visual — JSON array of group keys that are currently collapsed. Toggle by clicking the chevron in each group header.

columnFilters.description: Auto-managed by the visual — JSON object mapping column-name → filter spec (e.g. {"status": {"kind":"in","values":["On Track"]}}). Edit via the funnel icon on each column header.

savedViews.description: Auto-managed by the visual — JSON object of named view snapshots. Edit via the Views menu in the legend bar.

projectFeatures.description: On: the grid reads each row as a project — Timeline column, Ask chips, decision insights and Focus mode. Off: a plain table for any kind of data. The individual switches below still apply on top of this one.

showStatusBar.description: Let users drag over cells, as in Excel, and show Sum, Average, Count, Min and Max of the selection in a bar at the bottom of the grid.

showViewTabs.description: Show the sheet tabs at the bottom of the grid: ready-made layouts (Overview, Financial, Schedule, Health, Steering) built from the bound columns, followed by the saved views.

hiddenColumns.description: Auto-managed by the visual — JSON list of column names hidden from the grid. Edit via right-click on a column header, or the sheet tabs.

activeTab.description: Auto-managed by the visual — the sheet tab that was last chosen.

showQuestions.description: Show the row of business questions (What is late? Who is over budget? ...) that the bound data can answer. One click narrows and orders the grid and spells out the answer.

focusMode.description: Show only the projects that need attention (late, behind schedule, over budget, stalled or flagged at risk) with the reason per project. Viewers can switch it with the Focus button.

showTimeline.description: Draw a Timeline column (a bar per row from a start date to a finish date, filled by % done) when two date columns are bound to Columns.

timelineConfig.description: Auto-managed by the visual — JSON object naming the start, finish and progress columns of the Timeline column and its width. Edit via the gear on the Timeline header.

calcColumns.description: Auto-managed by the visual — JSON list of calculated columns (column A, a fixed operator, column B). Edit via the Calc button in the legend bar.

showHGridlines.description: Show horizontal lines between data rows.

indentLowestLevel.description: Add progressive left padding so the deepest row-identity column reads as indented under its parent groups.

mergeSingleChildLevels.description: Fold a level that has only one child into its parent's header ("Portfolio › Programme: A › B"). Off keeps one row per level, which is what a Row hierarchy usually wants.

rowDetailsInPanel.description: Open a row's details in the insight panel (default). Off puts the details block back under the row, as before v1.1.

showDrillControls.description: Render the drill-down / drill-up / expand-next-level chevrons in the action bar (standard Power BI visual drill features).

headerFontSize.description: Font size of the grid column header band. Default 12.5.

bodyFontSize.description: Font size of the grid data cells, subtotals, group headers, search, chevrons and chrome. Default 13.

kpiFontSize.description: Font size of the KPI tile value (the big number). Label / sub-text scale proportionally. Default 22.

titleFontSize.description: Font size of the top header title text. Default 15.

subtitleFontSize.description: Font size of the top header subtitle text. Default 11.

searchFontSize.description: Font size of the search input and its placeholder. Default 13.

buttonFontSize.description: Font size applied to action buttons (Copy, Views, Expand all, etc.) and the footer legend text. Default 11.5.

insightFontSize.description: Body font size inside the right-side insight panel. Default 12.

insightHeaderFontSize.description: Header / title font size inside the right-side insight panel. Default 13.

dialogFontSize.description: Base body font size of the in-visual configuration pop-up (labels, inputs, hints, buttons). Default 13.5.

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.

showSelectedRowInsights.description: When a row is selected, render a contextual block (rank, share, vs-peers) at the top of the insight panel.

accentColor.description: BFusion brand accent used in the insight panel (default orange #E8612A).
